s3_readme.left_p1: Building software has never been just about writing lines of code or chasing the latest framework hype. It's about deeply understanding the core problem, modeling domain boundaries accurately, and delivering solutions that feel effortless — from pixel to cloud infrastructure.
s3_readme.left_p2: I appreciate predictable systems that avoid hiding complexity beneath magic layers, and that genuinely respect the device resources of whoever is using them.
s3_readme.readme_intro: Software Engineer with a solid academic background from UFSM and hands-on experience architecting scalable applications and offline-first systems.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_1: Offline-First & Resilience: Software designed to operate seamlessly without depending on a perfect connection.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_2: Domain-Driven Architecture: Strict separation of concerns and predictable contracts across layers.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_3: Performance & Accessibility: 60fps responsive interfaces with crisp typography and reduced-motion support.
s3_readme.readme_pillar_4: Technical Pragmatism: The best solution is the one that solves the real bottleneck without accumulating hidden technical debt.
s3_readme.readme_now_text: Deepening into distributed microservices, on-device edge neural inference, and reactive primitives in Vue 3.
